scope: Component development policy only. Current project ordering is in the handoff; detailed past experiments are in the historical snapshot. No runtime schema migration or gate relaxation.

user_requested_component_normalization.user_clarification: we want 1W5 to go to DZ always

category_precedence: recognized Base Analog for legacy records
construction_hop_policy.sugar_form: DNA uses D-prefixed codes; RNA uses ribonucleotide codes, including U for T-category; unknown sugar is still a separate runtime error
construction_hop_policy.provenance: Existing mutation_actions.parent_code; no checkpoint/report schema migration

returned_category_hop_regression.context: After the validation ferry for category-hop commit 88e2f5369cfdcc4f5ad193fa089eae7eff0c814c

library_backed_continuation_policy.continue_when: Applicable library resolves the intended component and Phenix can interpret/refine it; retain source provenance and warning/inspection caveats for missing optional annotations or diagnostics.
necessary_stops: Unusable required definitions or scientific inputs
External execution cannot produce usable output
Contradictory required restraints after supported corrections
Silent target change or omission of an explicit required operation

generalization_review.ownership: NASolve construction/dictionaries; NARestraints retains atom-role and pair/stacking semantics
generalization_review.downstream_requirement: The intended normalized definition must actually reach refinement, not be replaced by a conflicting ReadySet definition.
generalization_review.torsion_current_dispatch: Input and effective dictionaries, independent of residue name and phosphate profiles; candidate pending live verification

guardrails: Pine merge gates and operational Scout priority live in the canonical handoff, not a duplicate evolving checklist here
Standing conversion direction is settled; audited derivative construction still needs implementation and validation
Preserve raw/frozen identities, source dictionaries, observations/Free-R and failed attempts
No arbitrary bond/protonation repair, blanket tautomer equivalence or inferred deposition rewrite
No installed-workbook changes, silent dictionary download, new 1W0 mapping or Scout authority promotion

dictionary_compatibility_candidate.source_test_scope: Isolated actual source with real Bio.PDB and stubs for unrelated NASolve imports; not full checkout or Phenix
dictionary_compatibility_candidate.unclassified_conflicts: retain unchanged with warnings for native interpretation

running_baseline_campaign.rule: Do not mutate its checkout until the campaign command returns; keep frozen baseline attempts unchanged
